chunks: O believers, many of the rabbis and priests devour the possessions of others wrongfully, and keep men away from the path of God. And those who accumulate gold and silver, and do not spend it in the way of God, announce to them the news of painful punishment.

key_terms.فَبَشِّرْهُمْ: So give them good tidings (of punishment)

ai.seo_question: What is the Quranic warning for hoarding wealth and misusing it?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a critique of religious elites who accumulate wealth while neglecting their duty to guide the community, a theme that resonates with the concept of *Ijtihad* requiring both knowledge and moral integrity. The warning against hoarding (*kanz*) highlights the spiritual danger of withholding resources from the path of God, emphasizing that true piety involves active charity and justice rather than mere accumulation. This serves as a timeless reminder for scholars and laypeople alike to ensure their material pursuits align with divine service.
